metadata.question: Are there more than two lakes (larger than 25 km square) in the region centered at coordinates (7.578886, 38.602260) within a 30 km radius, based on 2022 data?

data.raw_code: 1. Search strategy: - Use JRC Global Surface Water dataset (JRC/GSW1_4/GlobalSurfaceWater) which has occurrence data - Location: Point at (7.578886, 38.602260) with 30 km buffer - For 2022 data, I'll use the water occurrence band from the yearly history collection 2. Masking strategy: - Use water occurrence threshold (e.g., >50% occurrence = permanent water) - Identify connected water bodies (lakes) - Filter by size (>25 km²) 3. Logic: - Count distinct water bodies using connectedPixelCount - Calculate area of each water body - Filter those >25 km² - Count if more than 2 - Valid Zero (B): 0-2 lakes found - Yes (A): >2 lakes found - C1: No data available - C2: No valid water pixels after processing - C3: Calculation returns None/NaN ```python import ee ee.Initialize(project='earthsense-436113') # 1. Geometry & Time Definitions center = ee.Geometry.Point([7.578886, 38.602260]) region = center.buffer(30000) # 30 km radius # 2. Data Acquisition # Use JRC Global Surface Water Yearly History for 2022 gsw_yearly = ee.ImageCollection('JRC/GSW1_4/YearlyHistory') water_2022 = gsw_yearly.filter(ee.Filter.eq('year', 2022)).first() # Check if data exists if water_2022 is None: print("No JRC water data for 2022") print("C1") else: # 3. Processing - Extract permanent water bodies # Water class: 2 = permanent water, 3 = seasonal water # Focus on permanent water (class 2) permanent_water = water_2022.select('waterClass').eq(2) # Check if any water pixels exist water_count = permanent_water.reduceRegion( reducer=ee.Reducer.sum(), geometry=region, scale=30, maxPixels=1e9 ).get('waterClass').getInfo() if water_count is None or water_count == 0: print(f"No permanent water pixels found in region") print("C2") else: print(f"Total water pixels: {int(water_count)}") # 4. Identify connected water bodies and calculate areas # Label connected components connected = permanent_water.connectedPixelCount(maxSize=10000, eightConnected=True) # Calculate area of each water body (pixel count * pixel area) pixel_area = ee.Image.pixelArea() # in m² water_area = permanent_water.multiply(pixel_area) # Group by connected components and sum areas object_id = permanent_water.multiply(connected) area_by_object = water_area.reduceRegion( reducer=ee.Reducer.sum().group( groupField=0, groupName='object' ), geometry=region, scale=30, maxPixels=1e9 ).get('groups').getInfo() if area_by_object is None: print("Failed to calculate water body areas") print("C3") else: # Filter lakes larger than 25 km² (25,000,000 m²) large_lakes = [obj for obj in area_by_object if obj['sum'] > 25000000] num_large_lakes = len(large_lakes) print(f"Total water bodies detected: {len(area_by_object)}") print(f"Lakes larger than 25 km²: {num_large_lakes}") for i, lake in enumerate(large_lakes[:5]): # Show first 5 area_km2 = lake['sum'] / 1000000 print(f" Lake {i+1}: {area_km2:.1f} km²") # 5. Final Answer if num_large_lakes > 2: print("A") else: print("B") ```

import ee
ee.Initialize(project='earthsense-436113')

# 1. Geometry & Time Definitions
center = ee.Geometry.Point([7.578886, 38.602260])
region = center.buffer(30000)  # 30 km radius

# 2. Data Acquisition
# Use JRC Global Surface Water Yearly History for 2022
gsw_yearly = ee.ImageCollection('JRC/GSW1_4/YearlyHistory')
water_2022 = gsw_yearly.filter(ee.Filter.eq('year', 2022)).first()

# Check if data exists
if water_2022 is None:
    print("No JRC water data for 2022")
    print("<answer>C1</answer>")
else:
    # 3. Processing - Extract permanent water bodies
    # Water class: 2 = permanent water, 3 = seasonal water
    # Focus on permanent water (class 2)
    permanent_water = water_2022.select('waterClass').eq(2)
    
    # Check if any water pixels exist
    water_count = permanent_water.reduceRegion(
        reducer=ee.Reducer.sum(),
        geometry=region,
        scale=30,
        maxPixels=1e9
    ).get('waterClass').getInfo()
    
    if water_count is None or water_count == 0:
        print(f"No permanent water pixels found in region")
        print("<answer>C2</answer>")
    else:
        print(f"Total water pixels: {int(water_count)}")
        
        # 4. Identify connected water bodies and calculate areas
        # Label connected components
        connected = permanent_water.connectedPixelCount(maxSize=10000, eightConnected=True)
        
        # Calculate area of each water body (pixel count * pixel area)
        pixel_area = ee.Image.pixelArea()  # in m²
        water_area = permanent_water.multiply(pixel_area)
        
        # Group by connected components and sum areas
        object_id = permanent_water.multiply(connected)
        area_by_object = water_area.reduceRegion(
            reducer=ee.Reducer.sum().group(
                groupField=0,
                groupName='object'
            ),
            geometry=region,
            scale=30,
            maxPixels=1e9
        ).get('groups').getInfo()
        
        if area_by_object is None:
            print("Failed to calculate water body areas")
            print("<answer>C3</answer>")
        else:
            # Filter lakes larger than 25 km² (25,000,000 m²)
            large_lakes = [obj for obj in area_by_object if obj['sum'] > 25000000]
            num_large_lakes = len(large_lakes)
            
            print(f"Total water bodies detected: {len(area_by_object)}")
            print(f"Lakes larger than 25 km²: {num_large_lakes}")
            for i, lake in enumerate(large_lakes[:5]):  # Show first 5
                area_km2 = lake['sum'] / 1000000
                print(f"  Lake {i+1}: {area_km2:.1f} km²")
            
            # 5. Final Answer
            if num_large_lakes > 2:
                print("<answer>A</answer>")
            else:
                print("<answer>B</answer>")
